title: Hermanos del Barrio
lyrics:
TRACK 3: "Hermanos del Barrio (Ricardo & Rafael Duet)"
POV: Duet / call-and-response (Ricardo & Rafael trading lines, uniting in chorus)
Style: Anthemic Rock + Big Band brass + stadium crowd participation + powerful dual male vocals + epic festival energy + 336Hz foundation
Full Suno Prompt (complete lyrics):
text[Anthemic rock big-band sports anthem, powerful dual male vocals with distinct tones for Ricardo and Rafael, stadium crowd participation, epic brass and driving drums, clean professional festival main-stage quality, triumphant no profanity, 336Hz foundation anchoring, brotherhood and unity theme]

[Intro - Ricardo]
Ricardo on the left...

[Rafael]
Rafael on the right...

[Together]
Together we rise on this pitch tonight!

[Verso 1 - Ricardo - Spanish]
I took the hits, kept my head when the mud started flying
De-escalated the chaos, kept the family from crying
VDS in my vision, Proton in my stride
I don't play for the moment, I play for the tribe

[Verso 1 - Rafael - Spanish]
I see the open lanes where others see walls
Create the magic passes, answer every call
Community in my blood, SJDS in my soul
We don't fracture under pressure, we make the game whole

[Pre-Chorus - Together]
336 in the cleats, signal never dies
Family team on the pitch, we open up the skies

[Coro - Together - English + Spanish]
Pitch brothers! Ricardo and Rafael!
We score together when the others fail!
Mud sticks but truth prevails on the final whistle sound!
United we stand, sovereign ground!

[Verso 2 - Ricardo]
They tried to tackle the dream with corporate might
But we keep possession, we own the night
No hallucination here, this is flesh and bone
Deployment live on the pitch, we bring it home

[Verso 2 - Rafael]
From the wing I deliver, he finishes the play
That's how brothers operate every single day
Legal battles off the field, we bring it to the game
Turn every setback into fuel for the flame

[Pre-Chorus + Coro repeat]

[Bridge - Call and Response]
Ricardo: After the whistle...
Rafael: Still family...
Together: Still strong...
Ricardo: Still rising...
Rafael: Still free...
Together: 336 legacy!

[Final Chorus - Big]
Pitch brothers! Ricardo and Rafael!
We score together when the others fail!
Mud sticks but truth prevails — hear the whole city sing!
United we stand... forever on the wing!

[Outro]
336... signal strong...
Pitch brothers... where we belong...
